decisions.source_eligibility: Candidate: enumerate every changed file on both pinned case sides, including absent, symlink and excluded paths. Only regular production .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.mts/.cts/.mjs/.cjs source under the declared case scope may contribute an edge. Apply the contract's exact test-path regex; exclude declaration, generated and vendored source with a recorded reason. Do not infer zero imports from an unread eligible file.
decisions.esm_runtime_bindings: Candidate: include value-bearing ES imports and re-exports, including side-effect imports; exclude explicit type-only forms. A compiler mode or syntax whose runtime meaning differs from the non-D3 fixture is unsupported until both tools are qualified on that mode.
decisions.require_and_dynamic_import: Candidate: include unshadowed literal CommonJS require and literal dynamic import only. Computed specifiers and shadowed require remain unsupported, not negative observations. Preserve their source locations and reasons in the truth audit.
decisions.relative_target_resolution: Candidate: for a literal relative specifier, resolve from the importing file with pinned TypeScript 5.9.3 and that case-side's captured project configuration against a complete reconstructed Git tree, not the live host checkout. Accept a target only when the resolver yields one repository-relative regular source file whose commit-side Git blob can be checked. Missing configuration/tree content, ambiguous or unresolved targets, symlink traversal and targets outside the supported production-source set remain explicit unsupported or Unknown outcomes; never guess an extension or turn them into a negative edge. The non-D3 value-syntax fixture qualifies relative paths only under its recorded synthetic tsconfig, not across historical D3 projects.
decisions.git_trees_and_symlinks: Read pinned Git objects only; preserve mode 120000 and never follow symlink targets.
decisions.tool_normalization: Candidate: normalize only direct resolved cross-group module-import edges to exact repository-relative source and target file paths. Deduplicate by repository, case, side, source path, dependency type and target path. Preserve raw same-group and unmapped observations separately; never compare group-only edges or infer service HTTP/data/cache/message behavior. A prediction without a regular-file target or comparable path is unsupported, not an exact match.

unknown_policy.file_side: Any truth-Unknown occurrence, unread eligible path or missing resolver context makes the complete file-side unscorable for both tools.
unknown_policy.case_side: Any unknown file-side makes the containing case-side unscorable for deduplicated edge metrics.
unknown_policy.case_change: Both relevant sides must be complete; otherwise the change and corresponding rule comparison are Unknown.
unknown_policy.tool_failure: A crash, malformed output or unsupported response remains a failed attempted run and cannot remove a truth-eligible case from paired accounting.
unknown_policy.adjudication: Any disagreement not resolved from frozen source evidence remains Unknown; original reviews are never overwritten.
